title: Auto Shankar
desc: Shankar is an autorickshaw driver belonging to a middle-class family who gets into a conflict with Maya, a moneylender. However, tables turn when she loses her property, and they fall in love.

title: Ellaranthalla Nanna Ganda
desc: When Surya accuses Vishwa Prasad, a politician, of acquiring his position through political influence, Vishwa swears to destroy him.

title: Ayya
desc: An upright police officer is up against a conniving group of criminals. To put them behind bars, he devises a series of unconventional methods.

title: King of Kotha
desc: Heartbroken on being back-stabbed by his childhood friend, Raju, an influential man, runs away from his hometown, Kotha. Soon, to bring back order in the town, a police officer plots a plan.

title: Bindaas
desc: Shiva, a petty thief, falls in love with Preeti, the daughter of a police officer. However, her father forces Shiva to become an informer to keep him away.
